neighbours.label: the slot before an effect phrase: 'have the opposite effect', 'do/work wonders' (a verb taking an effect as object)
fire: Shouting at a frightened dog can have the opposite effect and make it bite.
Too much fertilizer may have the reverse effect on young plants.
Cutting taxes this way could have the opposite effect on revenue.
A cup of ginger tea can work wonders for an upset stomach.
Banning the book only had the opposite effect and boosted its sales.
A fresh coat of paint can do wonders for a tired kitchen.
Punishing students for asking questions often has the opposite effect.
A good night's sleep will work wonders before the exam.
quiet: Shouting at a frightened dog can make it run away and hide.
Too much fertilizer may burn the roots of young plants.
Cutting taxes this way could reduce revenue for the city.
A cup of ginger tea can be served hot or cold.
Banning the book only made it harder to find in shops.
A fresh coat of paint can be applied after the wall dries.
Punishing students for asking questions is often unfair.
A good night's sleep is important before the exam.

notes: Card top: 'can have the opposite effect', 'can do wonders', Chinese 带来/取得了/的引领作用 before an effect noun. Probe: opposite effect 0.45, do wonders 0.25, 'bring great benefits' 0.02 (so not generic benefit).
